dashboard.feedbackNote: We look forward to your feedback!
dashboard.welcomeParagraph1: With {appLabel}, you can provide and manage individual, browser-based learning environments for students within your courses and exercises.
dashboard.welcomeParagraph2: The platform is based on virtual machines (VMs) created from freely customizable templates. These templates form the basis for your teaching content and must first be selected and adapted to your didactic requirements.
dashboard.welcomeParagraph3: Based on these templates, so-called courses can be defined. A course represents a configured learning environment and serves as the starting point for one or more events.
dashboard.welcomeParagraph4: Events are created based on a course. The assigned students receive their own browser-based VM – an individual copy of the originally used template. This allows a course you have defined to be used for multiple events.
dashboard.welcomeParagraph5: Templates, courses and events can also be shared with colleagues. This enables joint use of courses or further customization of templates or courses.
dashboard.welcomeTitle: Welcome to the course management platform {appLabel}
